title: Kissed Smoke Hot Ukrainian Yellow Split Peas Pilaf
description: A buttery and chewy Ukrainian dish featuring yellow split peas, this paleo-friendly pilaf is perfect for kids and adults alike, with a smoky heat that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large terracotta dish, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the yellow split peas and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the dish with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the peas are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
